title: AI-Assisted Email Drafting
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting ai-assisted email drafting to AI critique log showing accepted, modified, and rejected suggestions, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Write a specific email prompt that names the recipient, course, exact request, deadline, and reason.
Run a verification pass on every fact (names, dates, the actual ask) before sending an AI-drafted message.
Keep private data (student ID, grades, personal details) out of public AI tools.
Keep a short log of which AI suggestions you accepted, modified, or rejected, and why.
